description.value: Steamworks Northshore is the newest location of Steamworks Brewing Co., a well-established British Columbia craft beer brand, operating as a taphouse and full-service restaurant on the North Shore. The space pours signature Steamworks brews alongside rotating guest taps celebrating the local craft scene, served in a group-friendly dining room with an expansive patio. The kitchen offers pub favourites, fusion creations, plant-based dishes, and weekend brunch — a solid refuelling stop for cyclists coming off the North Shore trails.
